property_summary: Any position minted by fillOrder must be owned by its recipient, so an owner can transfer it via transferFrom without reverting; the mutant mints with _ownerOf set to address(0), so the same transferFrom reverts with WRONG_FROM.
change_summary: Mint sets `_ownerOf[id] = address(0);` instead of `_ownerOf[id] = to;`, so newly minted positions appear unowned.
